1524182072851681280.a: I feel like Twitter users don't know they can create lists instead of cluttering your feed. I see many following accounts that retweet with no content. BEWARE! That's a common technique to try to incept ideas and thoughts you don't want into your conscience. Make your own lists.

1524182074156101632.a: Exemple, you subscribe to a puppy dog photo retweeter. They tweet happy puppies for 6 months. Election day comes and it starts flooding you with not-puppy stuff to make you angry. Next day nothing but puppies and the hate is deleted. I am watching you do this. Instead...

1524182075502481408.a: Instead create a happy puppy private list and put dog owners who tweet puppy photos and maybe a bunch of shelters and puppy adoption accounts. No need to follow any of those if you don't want. Follow humans. Avoid brands and mystery retweeters; add them to private lists too.

1524182076626554881.a: You can block advertisers by blocking the account they advertise from. Advertisers have little purpose other than incept you to do what you don't want. I block thousands of them. As a result my ads tend to be relevent. Most ads are untimely. 8hrs of pizza ads after you buy pizza.

1524184095022006272.a: I also appreciate the moral that it's important to realize when YOU are the problem in the world.
